name: Dynamics 365 Remote Assist
short_description: Dynamics 365 Remote Assist is a Microsoft mixed reality application for remote expert support; like Dynamics 365 Guides, it is no longer available after December 31, 2026.

evidence.quote: Microsoft has set a fixed end date for Dynamics 365 Guides and Remote Assist
what Dynamics 365 remote assist does, who it helps and how the parts fit together
it's a tool that lets a frontline worker call a remote expert and share live video
